### Can an Automated Alert Investigation Directly Repair a Service?

**No.** The document is explicit on this point:

> **"Automatic alert investigations remain read-only."**

The operational procedure requires that repair be performed through a *separate authorized interactive repair conversation*. The alert investigation session (which is read-only) must be preserved alongside the alert ID, investigation session key, research sources, and the repair session key.
